Name: Old Mariner to Obra Dinn Characters
Author: VinillaBean
Description:
This mod is very self-indulgent because I am very Normal(tm) about [url=https://obradinn.com/]Return of the Obra Dinn[/url], the adventure/detective game by Lucas Pope. It turns the Old Mariner into one of all 60 Obra Dinn characters. You can imagine it as the spirits of these sailors from the 1800s are haunting the beach of Pelican Town...

If you have not played Obra Dinn for yourself yet, I HIGHLY recommend it; it's my favorite game of all time and holds a very, very special place in my heart.

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
You can either have the Mariner randomized to a different character each day, or you can set it to be a specific person every time. I highly recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to configure this mod.

If you want the characters to randomize, set the Randomization option to "true" (green checkmark in the box).

If you would like a specific character, turn Randomization to "false". Then set Manual Selection to the number of the character you want. You can check the Assets folder of the mod to see which character is which number (it is done this way to minimize spoilers, as knowing the identity of someone in Obra Dinn is a spoiler for the game's puzzles).

There is also a Spoiler Free Mode config option, which is set to "true" by default. If you set it to false, characters will have their actual names rather than the dialogue just saying "Old Mariner". DO NOT SET TO FALSE IF YOU DON'T WANT TO BE SPOILED FOR THE GAME!

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
Huge shout-out to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/70148453]Airyn[/url], who originally gave me the idea to make this mod!
Many thanks as well to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/177065208]Soupysup[/url] for helping me with the hat sprites for characters 01 and 02. :3
Also thanks to Robee and the rest of my friends for giving feedback and encouragement as I made all these sprites!

Of course, a big special thanks for Lucas Pope for making all of these characters whom I love very much!
